{{Top|leg}}
A '''thistled scrub''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fennesa/Legends|Fennesa]]. The [[mountain nerf]]s on the world ate the scrubs as part of their [[Diet/Legends|diet]].<ref name="MN">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030206nerf|series=Creature Feature|text=Mountain Nerf}}</ref>
